The CI capture script domain-split/play/capture.cjs, its Off-Brand routine unchanged, re-run locally in headless Chromium against the built Play tree (Lessons 357d841f) from local commit fb34ede6, whose offbrand/index.html is byte-identical to this PR's. Every frame reviewed at 1 per second by Claude and the ruling thread: game UI text only (crew shape names, room names, case number), no real person, place or organisation name.
